findingDetails.title: edit_lines interior-hash verification is conditional, contradicting its stated invariant
findingDetails.description: Interior lines of an edit range are verified only when the caller supplies the optional line_hashes array; a schema-legal minimal call can silently overwrite interior drift with unchanged endpoints and line count.
findingDetails.impact: Silent wrong-line writes are the failure class edit_lines exists to prevent.
findingDetails.recommendation: Require line_hashes for multi-line edits, or verify interiors unconditionally from a re-read, or correct the comment and tool docs to state the endpoint-plus-line-count baseline.
findingDetails.scopeProof: section 11 is in scope per goal-file-manifest.txt

findingDetails.title: directive-dedup normalization never participates in dedup identity
findingDetails.description: splitPiDirectiveBrief normalizes headless briefs to a shared form but decidePiDirectiveDelivery compares raw context, so headed and headless briefs never share a dedup key as the comment claims.
findingDetails.impact: Fail-open today; latent trap for maintainers who trust the comment.
findingDetails.recommendation: Compare on the normalized parts, or reword the comment to describe raw-content identity.
findingDetails.scopeProof: phase 3 changed this file per goal-file-manifest.txt

findingDetails.title: review-side step_convergence_report never folds lineage state logs
findingDetails.description: The review close reads only the root state log and hydrates totalIterations from the loop counter, while the research sibling folds lineage logs; in fan-out closes the root log is absent so invariants are vacuous and totalIterations reports 0.
findingDetails.impact: Misleading synthesis telemetry; verdict logic unaffected.
findingDetails.recommendation: Fold lineage state logs in the review variant as deep-research-auto.yaml:2185-2188 does.
findingDetails.scopeProof: only step_convergence_report is in scope for the four deep-loop YAMLs
